title: Standard charts and the twisting module on Proj of a polynomial ring over A
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $m\ge0$, $S=A[x_0,\dots,x_m]$ graded by total degree, and $P=\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-pc-proj]. Put $U_k=D_+(x_k)$ and let $\mathcal O_P(1)$ be the twisting module of [def-pc-projective-space-twist], with its local basis $e_k=e_k^{(1)}$ on $U_k$. Then the $U_k$ cover $P$, each $U_k$ is canonically $\operatorname{Spec}(S_{(x_k)})$ with $S_{(x_k)}$ the degree-zero part of $S_{x_k}$ [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero], and the map $A[Y_l:l\ne k]\to S_{(x_k)}$ sending $Y_l$ to $x_l/x_k$ is an $A$-algebra isomorphism. On $U_k\cap U_l$, $e_l=(x_l/x_k)e_k$; moreover $U_k\cap U_l$ is the basic open of the function $x_l/x_k$ in $U_k$. There is a unique morphism of schemes $q:P\to\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] (the structure morphism) whose restriction to each $U_k=\operatorname{Spec}(S_{(x_k)})$ is the morphism $\operatorname{Spec}(S_{(x_k)})\to\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ induced by the ring map $A\to S_{(x_k)}$, $a\mapsto a/1$.
